Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to account for nuanced dual nationality descriptors. It relied on a deterministic heuristic by identifying Jacques Sernas solely as "French" based on the profession-associated demonym ("French actor"), neglecting the complexity of hyphenated terms (e.g., "Lithuanian-born French actor") commonly found in biographies. This misinterpretation led to an incorrect understanding of Sernas' dual nationality (Lithuanian by birth and French citizen through naturalization).
